scripts.kill:backend: for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr :8000 ^| findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /pid %a /f
scripts.kill:frontend: for /f "tokens=5" %a in ('netstat -ano ^| findstr :5173 ^| findstr LISTENING') do taskkill /pid %a /f
scripts.backend: npm run kill:backend 2>nul & cd backend && venv\Scripts\uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.frontend: npm run kill:frontend 2>nul & cd frontend && npm run dev
scripts.dev: start npm run backend && npm run frontend
